snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID1: Lenny, the undefeated surfing champion, is at the beach and he's waiting for you!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID10: Hello! It's great that you're back!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID15: The new furniture and clothing collections are here. Have a look in the catalogue!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID16: Have you already seen the pirate bar in the harbor? There you'll be able to really let loose!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID2: From today you can show all your friends what a brainiac you are with the new quiz! Just go to San Franpanfu and then click on the quiz wagon. Good luck!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID3: Have you already read the daily pearl of wisdom in the crystal ball?
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID4: Wow! Now when a panda is bothering or annoying you, you can ignore them! Just click on the red smiley in their player card.
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID5: Every Friday, Saturday and Sunday you can watch the sun rise and set from the volcano. When the stars are bright there is an incredible firework show. It's not to be missed!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID6: Have you already heard that there'll be a pirate party? You'll be able to go all out! Get in the boat, head to the island and get partying!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID7: Have you already tried out the monster water slide at the Wooby lake? Get yourself a swimming tire and give it a go!
snippets.ASSISTANT_CONTEMPORARY_ID8: Have you tried the multi-player game HOT BOOM which is in the Gym? Check it out!
